Propose New Candidate Points

propose_candidates.Rd

Implements the epsilon-LCB acquisition strategy: exploitation (minimize predicted value) and exploration (maximize uncertainty).

Usage

propose_candidates(
  model_list,
  x_train,
  y_train,
  x_min,
  x_max,
  n_candidates,
  exploit_ratio = 0.5,
  n_starting = 20,
  tolerance = 0.01
)

Arguments

model_list

List of trained neural networks

x_train

Current training data

y_train

Current training targets

x_min

Lower bound for parameters

x_max

Upper bound for parameters

n_candidates

Number of candidate points to propose

exploit_ratio

Fraction of candidates for exploitation vs exploration (default 0.5)

n_starting

Number of random starting points for optimization

tolerance

Optimization tolerance

Value

Matrix of proposed candidate points
